payload.title: RM W1 One machine, first panels: Session, Registers panel, glass strip, c1/02 04 05
payload.description: Real-machine plan (docs/real-machine-curriculum.md section 6). Each wave ships alone and ends with lessons on the path. Contents: Session in the explorer; lesson Live over it; RealStage without the shadow timeline; the Registers panel (box skin) and the glass strip; c1/02, 04 and 05 updated. FIRST SHIPPABLE WAVE after the pilot. Riskiest assumption: one component can be the 3-box lesson look and the 32-register IDE table without making either worse. Guardian playtest question: In c1/02, does she notice the grey line change, and what does she say it is?
